observation.body:
Legacy identity: `FOS-000019`. Original source: [immutable historical definition](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/73f891d6c0cf498ac92e804d7d0f0cd344a083f5/local-docs/reviews/observability-sweep.md).

Shared requirements and grouping: https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/issues/8. All original criteria below remain required. Source status statements below describe their historical revision; current delivery evidence is recorded separately. Original relative links are resolved below.

## Original definition (verbatim)

19. **FOS-000019 — Publish capture completeness without changing application results.** **M; depends on `FOS-000017`, `FOS-000018`; §1–§2, §6.** [layer dispatch:1203](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/556da9ff7d7616704dda515756219ab1dab693ec/layer/dispatch.cpp#L1203) already preserves driver results across ordinary recording failures; build on that. [instance:509](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/556da9ff7d7616704dda515756219ab1dab693ec/layer/instance.cpp#L509) creates/configures the recorder but has no persistent capture-outcome interface. Add per-recorder/application scope status, explicit filtered/disabled state, missing resources and finalization outcome, then a documented query/report mechanism owned by the layer/integrator. **Check:** Vulkan success plus capture failure, capture unsupported feature, failed prepare, concurrent instances/devices and teardown. Do not conflate application compilation failure with recording loss. The opt-in emergency-dump modes intentionally alter signal handling; retain and disclose that mode rather than claiming every current mode guarantees host continuity.

   **Required automated success criteria — pending implementation:**

   - **Layer integration tests using a controlled Vulkan dispatch:** When the driver succeeds and capture prepare/record/finalization fails, the application receives the same Vulkan result and valid handles as the capture-disabled control; queryable capture status reports the separate loss. When the driver fails, its raw result is preserved without inventing capture success.
   - **Capture lifetime/isolation tests:** Concurrent instances/devices keep scope and outcomes isolated; filtered/disabled capture, unsupported recording, teardown and failed finalization remain distinguishable. Ordinary operation continues after recoverable capture faults. Emergency-dump mode is explicitly identified and tested separately from ordinary continuity guarantees.
